articles.title: India, Japan to conduct two-week air exercise Veer Guardian 2026 in Jodhpur from today
articles.summary: The Indian Air Force (IAF) and Japan Air Self Defence Force (JASDF) are preparing for the bilateral Air Exercise, Veer Guardian-2026. This joint drill aims to enhance interoperability, share best practices, and strengthen defence cooperation between the two nations' air forces. Such exercises are vital for improving combat readiness and fostering strategic partnerships in the Indo-Pacific, offering valuable insights for future military officers.

articles.title: Iran seizes US submarine drone, Houthis hit four Saudi cities
articles.summary: Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi rebels launched a significant attack on four cities in southern Saudi Arabia, a key US ally, on Tuesday. The assault wounded 73 people and set oil installations ablaze, indicating a major escalation. This incident underscores ongoing regional instability and the persistent threat to critical infrastructure in the Middle East, highlighting complex security challenges for international players.
